en: Black-and-white photograph of the interior of a large Gothic church or cathedral, showing a long central nave flanked by tall clustered columns and pointed ribbed vaults. Wooden pews line both sides of the central aisle, which leads toward a distant altar and a large tracery window. A stone pulpit projects from the left side, and ornate carved screens and religious artwork are visible near the altar.
